_lz4.source_equivalence: All files in the release lib/ directory are byte-identical to the ClickHouse submodule. The module's frame target includes the same four C translation units.
_lz4.configuration: lz4-fast-decoder.patch preserves LZ4_FAST_DEC_LOOP=1 on both architectures. BCR namespaces its internal xxHash symbols as LZ4_; ClickHouse uses the separate inline xxHash implementation.
